 Provedel against Shakhtar? Watch out for corners: in 2022 he scored a Champions League header
 Serie A 
 Calcio 
 Ivan boasts two career goals, one in Serie B and the other in Europe's elite competition, scored against Oblak's Atletico during his Lazio days. All thanks to his past as a striker in youth football
 Francesco Pietrella 
 20 october (modifica alle 16:20) - MILANO 
 Italian version 
 Scegli Gazzetta come fonte preferita su Google 
 Provedel's goal against Atletico Madrid. 
 A warning for Shakhtar fans: watch out for the lad in yellow. Arda Turan and his men will surely also have worked out how to mark Ivan Provedel, the goalscoring goalkeeper. Over the course of his career he has already struck twice: the first time in Serie B, with Juve Stabia, the second with Lazio, in the Champions League. It was his debut in the competition. In the 95th minute he went up into the box from a corner on the left and beat Oblak with a genuine striker's header, thanks to a past spent as a forward. Indeed, before turning to goalkeeping gloves, Provedel wore the number nine shirt.
 VIDEO: Bombardato e chiuso dal 2014: cosa succederà allo stadio dello Shakhtar 
 provedel: is it his turn?
—   On Wednesday he could make his debut against Shakhtar, taking his place between the posts for the Nerazzurri after an excellent pre-season. Having arrived in the summer from Lazio, so far he has trained quietly, respecting the pecking order: Martinez first, him second. Who knows whether something might change between now and the end of the season, but at the moment Chivu's choice remains this one. However, regardless of Martinez's errors, Provedel is ready for his Nerazzurri debut in a peculiar context. Coming to San Siro are Shakhtar Donetsk, the Ukrainian side in exile for 12 years (the Donbass Arena has been unusable since 2014, the year it was bombed). Provedel's mother is Russian, while his grandfather enlisted in the army alongside Lev Yashin. It goes without saying that Russia and Ukraine are at war. A few years ago, after his goal against Atletico, the federation contacted the Inter number one over a possible call-up, but Ivan turned it down. Vitaliy Kafanov, the national team's goalkeeping coach, revealed as much: "I asked the federation to put me in touch with him, but he reiterated to us that he did not want to speak to anyone". In any case, Provedel could never have played for Russia. The reason? He does not hold citizenship. 
 seizing the moment
—   Ivan knows how to seize the moment: in 2022 he claimed the Lazio goal by capitalising on someone else's mistake. Matchday one, a packed Stadio Olimpico, debut against Bologna. Between the posts was Luis Maximiano, signed from Granada for €10 million. After five minutes, the Portuguese was sent off for handling the ball outside the penalty box. An incredible lapse in judgment. Provedel came on and steered the Biancocelesti to a 2-1 victory. From that day on he played every match, while Maximiano was only seen in the cups. On the pitch was Provedel, the lad capable of coming up for corners when the match gets gritty.
